findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.evidence: Header CSP tidak ditemukan; meningkatkan risiko XSS dan injeksi skrip eksternal.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking Risk)
findings.evidence: Halaman dapat dimuat di dalam <iframe> lintas domain.
findings.remediation: Set header X-Frame-Options: DENY atau SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.evidence: URL sensitif beserta parameter query berisiko bocor melalui header Referer ke pihak ketiga.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
findings.evidence: Koneksi HTTPS tidak menyertakan header Strict-Transport-Security.

findings.title: Runtime / Backend Framework Version Disclosure
findings.remediation: Nonaktifkan header X-Powered-By dan perbarui runtime ke rilis LTS terbaru.
